I wish it worked. I was really hoping this app would work, but it really didn’t for me. I scanned a series of photo slides from the 50’s-80’s and I was hoping that for the best quality ones, it would remove the dust flecks on the slides and on the worst ones cracking from water damage due to Hurricane Katrina. 

For the easiest ones, I tried an example of my dad on a camel in Egypt. There were flecks in the perfect blue sky due to dust on the pic when I scanned it (I didn’t see it until after I scanned them). Rather that dusting the slide and risk scratching it, I thought to try to see if it could be easily digitally removed. Did the dust get removed…well yes and no. Roughly 30% were removed, but so was part (only part) of a telephone pole and camel’s neck was badly blurred like a novice discovering and using the smudge tool for the first time. So it did a lot more harm then good. 

For the more difficult one, there was a picture of my brother when he was a toddler on a sailboat. This picture was cracked similar to some of the examples they show. Instead of fixing the cracking, it removed parts of the boat and enhanced the color, which made the cracks even worse.

I am really not convinced that any of the images they provide examples of were actually used in this program based on my experience so far. I have the free Pro version for another few days and will see what happens. I will gladly revise this review if I get better results.

Top of my list for restoring photos. This app is outstanding. I am constantly working on photos… I have boxes of family albums as well as projects on social media. This app is fabulous for creating detail in blurry old photos. 

I have learned over time, when I try to bring a photo memory back to life, if I can’t make out great grandmas eyeballs at a glance, an AI app will struggle to give her the exact match and will have to make its best guess. With all of the photo apps I have tried, I have seen some hysterical photos when it was too difficult to find a good match, but for me, this app is at the top for getting the best matches. 

I find editing your picture first to eliminate shadows and make it easier for the app to identify features really helps. I also will use a second editing app like Facetune to smooth out random features that are off.
